errors.text: The proposed zirconium getter is incorrect relative to the target titanium-sponge getter.
Homogeneously mixing Zr getter into the precursor would tend to form internal ZrO2 inclusions and alter local alloy chemistry rather than remove oxygen from the specimen as an external getter does.
The proposed argon atmosphere and 1350°C homogenization/quench regime conflict with vacuum sintering below 3×10⁻⁶ torr at 1400°C for 18 hours followed by water quenching from 1500°C.
The predicted grain size below 5 µm is incompatible with the reported post-quench grain size of 33 ± 19 µm.
The hypothesis treats oxygen minimization as the objective, whereas the target process retains approximately 1 wt.% oxygen for interstitial strengthening while avoiding HCP phase formation.
